entities.name: William Johnson
entities.explicit_context: William Johnson is a common English name representing a typical individual in Western society. The name follows standard English naming conventions with given name (William) followed by family name (Johnson), and commonly appears with nickname variations like Will, Bill, and Billy in informal contexts.

entities.name: Dr. Sarah Williams
entities.description: Test case for titles and honorifics
entities.explicit_context: Dr. Sarah Williams is a medical professional and healthcare provider who has earned a doctoral degree in medicine. She represents the medical community and healthcare sector, where professional titles and honorifics are important for establishing credibility and authority in patient care and medical practice.

entities.name: Leo Tolstoy
entities.explicit_context: Leo Nikolayevich Tolstoy (born 9 September 1828, died 20 November 1910) was a Russian writer and philosopher, regarded as one of the greatest authors of all time. He is best known for his novels War and Peace and Anna Karenina. Tolstoy was a member of the Russian nobility and is considered a master of realistic fiction and one of the world's greatest novelists.

entities.name: Xi Jinping
entities.explicit_context: Xi Jinping (born 15 June 1953) is a Chinese politician who has been serving as the General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and President of the People's Republic of China since 2012. He is the paramount leader of China and has been described as the most powerful Chinese leader since Mao Zedong, overseeing China's economic growth and international relations.

entities.name: Tesla Inc
entities.explicit_context: Tesla, Inc. is an American electric vehicle and clean energy company founded by Elon Musk in 2003. The company is known for its electric cars, energy storage systems, and solar panels, and has become one of the world's most valuable automakers by market capitalization, revolutionizing the automotive industry with sustainable transportation solutions.
